levels.name: The Scent Remained
levels.description: Increases the maximum number of Rain Swords by 1.

levels.name: Rainbow Upon the Azure Sky
levels.description: Extends the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3s. Decreases the Hydro RES of opponents hit by sword rain attacks by 15% for 4s

levels.name: Weaver of Verses
levels.description: Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Raincutter by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Evilsoother
levels.description: Throughout the duration of Guhua Sword: Raincutter, the DMG dealt by Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen is increased by 50%.

levels.name: Embrace of Rain
levels.description: Increases the Level of Guhua Sword: Fatal Rainscreen by 3. Maximum upgrade level is 15.

levels.name: Hence, Call Them My Own Verses
levels.description: Activating 2 of Guhua Sword: Raincutter's sword rain attacks greatly enhances the third sword rain attack. On hit, the third sword rain attack also regenerates 3 Energy for Xingqiu.
